questions.stem: What is the weather like there?

options.A: I like the food they serve.
options.C: I'm not sure whether I’ll like it.

questions.explain:
What is ... like: ...怎麼樣
weather: 天氣
whether: 是否
解析：題意詢問「那裡的天氣如何？」，因此答案選D（今天晴朗但涼爽）。干擾選項A是利用題目中的like作字面陷阱；B將weather誤聽為音近的waiter（服務生）；C則是利用同音字whether（是否）來混淆聽力。

questions.stem: Where is the gym you are going to?
questions.explain:
gym: 健身房
across the street: 在街對面
crowded with: 擠滿...
解析：題意為「你要去的健身房在哪裡？」問句用 Where 詢問健身房的位置，故答案選B。干擾選項 A 回答自己要去市區、C 說哪都不去，都是針對人的動向而非地點；D 描述人潮擁擠，答非所問。

questions.stem: Where can I mail this package?
questions.explain:
mail: 郵寄
package: 包裹
post office: 郵局
解析：題意為「我可以在哪裡寄這個包裹？」，寄送包裹必須去郵局，故答案選D。選項A（超市）、B（學校圖書館）與C（公車總站）雖然都是常見公共場所，但均非專門處理郵務的地點，屬於單純的地點混淆陷阱。

questions.stem: Did you get your hair cut?

options.A: No, I don't want to dye my hair.
options.B: Yes, I just came back from the barber’s.
options.C: No, I didn't cut my finger.

questions.explain:
get one's hair cut: 剪頭髮
barber's: 理髮店
shortcut: 捷徑
解析：題意為問對方「你剪頭髮了嗎？」，回答剛從理髮店回來符合語意，故答案選B。選項A提到染髮偏離題意；選項C切傷手指與選項D走捷徑，皆是利用單字cut設計的字面干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: Was your flight on time?

options.D: No, I was in no hurry.

questions.explain:
flight: 航班
on time: 準時
punctual: 準時的
解析：題目詢問「你的航班準時嗎？」，片語 on time 與單字 punctual 為同義詞，故答案選A。選項B利用 frightened（害怕的）與 flight 音近設陷阱；選項C回答 Yes 後面卻說遲到20分鐘，前後語意矛盾；選項D說不趕時間，答非所問。

questions.stem: What weapons do your men use?

options.B: They use knives to cut meat.
options.C: They use rifles most of the time.
options.D: They use credit cards most of the time.

questions.explain:
weapon: 武器
men: 部屬、士兵
rifle: 步槍、來福槍
解析：題意詢問「你的士兵使用什麼武器？」。rifles（步槍）屬於軍事武器，符合問句核心，故答案選C。干擾項A的forks（叉子）與B的knives（餐刀）是指餐具，並非戰鬥武器；D的credit cards（信用卡）更與武器無關，皆為字面動作干擾。

questions.stem: Can I use a check or credit card?

options.B: No, you needn't be so polite.
options.D: No, you can't have it both ways.

questions.explain:
credit card: 信用卡
either: 兩者中任一個
double-check: 再次檢查
解析：題意為詢問能否用支票或信用卡付款。either表示兩者皆可，故答案選C。選項A利用double-check（再檢查）混淆check（支票）字義；選項D意為不能兩全其美，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Is Giovanni your neighbor?

options.B: Yes, he lives next door to us.

questions.explain:
neighbor: 鄰居
next door: 隔壁
nephew: 姪子、外甥
解析：題意詢問「喬凡尼是你的鄰居嗎？」，選項 B 回答「是的，他住在我們隔壁」完全符合 neighbor 的定義，故答案選B。選項 A 的 nephew 與 C 的 Naples 都是字首發音與 neighbor 相近的聽力混淆陷阱，D 則答非所問。

questions.stem: What are usually used to carry wounded soldiers on the battlefield?
questions.explain:
wounded soldier: 傷兵
battlefield: 戰場
stretcher: 擔架
解析：題意為「在戰場上通常用什麼來運送受傷的士兵？」擔架是用來抬送傷患的軍醫裝備，故答案選B。選項A橋樑、C水桶、D鏟子皆為工兵或一般用具，無法用來運送傷兵，屬於不合常理的字義干擾選項。

questions.stem: Why must I wear a helmet?

options.A: Well, it's supposed to be a formal occasion.
options.C: well, it's only a matter of time.
options.D: Well, better small fish than an empty dish.

questions.explain:
helmet: 安全帽、頭盔
better safe than sorry: 有備無患
解析：問句詢問「為什麼我必須戴安全帽？」核心在於安全考量。better safe than sorry 意為「有備無患、安全第一」，符合預防危險的情境，故答案選B。選項A指正式場合不合常理；C（只是時間問題）與D（聊勝於無）皆為無關題意的俗諺干擾。

questions.stem: Who broke the window?

options.B: John was sitting near the window.

questions.explain:
break: 打破
broke: 沒錢的、破產的
have no idea: 不知道
解析：題意為「誰打破了窗戶？」。因不知情而回答「我不知道」，答案選D。干擾選項A答非所問提及電視；B僅說明位置並未指認兇手；C利用broke的一字多義設下字面陷阱，指「身無分文」而非打破。

questions.stem: Which of the following can a plumber do?
questions.explain:
plumber: 水管工人、水電工
repair leaks: 修理漏水
prescribe drugs: 開處方藥
解析：題意問水管工人能做什麼。水管工主要負責修繕水管設備，故答案選A。干擾選項B開藥是醫生（doctor）的工作，C種菜是農夫的職責，D算命則是算命師的專長，皆為職業內容混淆的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Is that a guide dog?

options.C: Yes, it's a Seeing Eye dog.

questions.explain:
guide dog: 導盲犬
Seeing Eye dog: 導盲犬
police dog: 警犬
hunting dog: 獵犬
解析：題目詢問「那是導盲犬嗎？」。guide dog 與 Seeing Eye dog 為同義詞，皆指引導視障者的導盲犬，因此答案選C。選項A的野狗（wild dog）、選項B的警犬（police dog）與選項D的獵犬（hunting dog）皆為不同功能犬種的字面干擾。

questions.stem: Is that guy your coach?

options.A: No, he does not belong to our church.
options.B: Yes, he came here by coach.
options.C: No, he is not my type.
options.D: Yes, he is my personal trainer.

questions.explain:
coach: 教練；長途巴士
personal trainer: 個人健身教練
解析：題意問「那個人是你的教練嗎？」。coach 在此指運動教練，與 personal trainer 意思相近，故答案選D。選項A的 church 是發音相近的干擾；選項B利用 coach 另一個意思「長途巴士」設下字面陷阱；選項C指不是自己喜歡的型，答非所問。

questions.stem: What's the quickest way for us to get there?
questions.explain:
quickest way: 最快的方式
get there: 到達那裡
by subway: 搭乘地鐵
解析：題目詢問前往該處最快的方式，答案選C，以交通工具清楚回答路徑。干擾選項B意為轉眼間，雖形容時間短但非交通手段；A為長遠來看，D為相較之下，皆為混淆視聽的片語陷阱。

questions.stem: Are you sure you did not forget anything?

options.A: I'm sure I'll like everything you do.
options.B: Wow, you've bought so many things.
options.C: Oh, no! I left my camera in the taxi!

questions.explain:
forget: 忘記
leave in: 遺留在
解析：題目問「你確定沒有忘記任何東西嗎？」，答案選C，表示突然想起把相機留在計程車上，符合遺漏物品的語境。干擾選項A借用sure與thing設置字面陷阱；B說買很多東西、D表示容易取悅，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Are you really a physician?

options.A: No, I can't predict it with precision.

questions.explain:
physician: 醫師、內科醫生
precision: 精確、精準
technician: 技術員
解析：題意為「你真的是一名醫生嗎？」。physician 與 doctor 同義，皆指醫生，故答案選D。選項A的 precision、B的 preparation 與 C的 technician 都是發音或字尾相似（-cian/-sion/-tion）的聽力干擾陷阱，語意完全不合。

questions.stem: May I smoke in here?

options.A: You'd better not. Ventilation is very bad.
options.C: You may stay here until you want to leave.
options.D: I'm not used to the smog in the city.

questions.explain:
ventilation: 通風
quit smoking: 戒菸
smog: 煙霧、霧霾
解析：題意為「我可以在這裡抽菸嗎？」。A選項回覆「最好不要，通風很差」最符合情境，故答案選A。B答非所問提到自己戒菸；C回答停留時間離題；D用相關字smog製造字面陷阱。

questions.stem: How's your headache?

options.A: I must have caught a cold.
options.B: It's because I'm in trouble again.
options.C: I stayed up until very late last night.

questions.explain:
headache: 頭痛
catch a cold: 感冒
stay up: 熬夜
解析：題目詢問頭痛目前的狀況如何。D 表示痛感幾乎消失了，正面回應病況，故答案選D。A、B、C 分別提到感冒、惹麻煩與熬夜，皆是在解釋頭痛發生的原因，屬於答非所問的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Do you like eating sashimi?

options.B: No, I never eat anything raw.
options.C: Yes, I cook everything at home’.

questions.explain:
sashimi: 生魚片
raw: 生的、未煮過的
解析：題目問「你喜歡吃生魚片嗎？」。生魚片是未煮熟的生食，故答案選B「不，我從不吃生食」邏輯相符。干擾選項A扯到蔬菜偏離題意；C說在家煮飯、D說自己不是廚師，皆與是否喜歡吃生魚片無關，屬於答非所問。

questions.stem: Can I have a hamburger and a large coke?

options.A: Yes, for here or to go?
options.B: No, the hamburger isn’t large enough.

questions.explain:
for here or to go: 內用還是外帶
diet coke: 低卡可樂
解析：題意為顧客在速食店點餐「我可以要一個漢堡和大杯可樂嗎？」。店員接單並詢問「好的，內用還是外帶？」，符合情境，故答案選A。選項B不符邏輯；C為點餐者的口吻，非店員回應；D則是利用cold混淆題目中的coke發音。

questions.stem: Whose turn is it to dump the trash?
questions.explain:
one's turn: 輪到某人
dump the trash: 倒垃圾
recycle: 回收
解析：題目問「輪到誰倒垃圾了？」，詢問輪流的對象，因此答案選A（我想是我）。選項B、C、D分別針對垃圾很重、可回收或造成污染等字面細節發揮，皆屬於答非所問的干擾項。

questions.stem: Where are your going to withdraw money?
questions.explain:
withdraw money: 領錢、提款
ATM: 自動櫃員機
co-worker: 同事
解析：本題詢問「你要去哪裡領錢？」。withdraw money 為提款，疑問詞 Where 問地點，領錢的合適地點為自動櫃員機，故答案選C。干擾項 A（工程師）與 B（同事）是向人借錢而非提款地點，D（博物館）則非領錢場所，皆不合邏輯。

questions.stem: Why don't you go take a nap?

options.A: But I'm not tired at all.
options.B: But it doesn't belong to me.
options.D: But it isn't having a sale.

questions.explain:
take a nap: 小睡；打盹
Why don't you...?: 你何不……？（表建議）
not at all: 一點也不
解析：題幹意為「你何不去小睡一下？」是建議對方休息。A回應「但我一點也不累」符合情境，故答案選A。B表示不屬於我、C表示很有空、D表示沒在特價，語意皆完全文不對題。

questions.stem: Is Sergeant Lee your relative?

options.B: No, we do not get along.
options.D: No, he has not returned yet.

questions.explain:
Sergeant: 中士
relative: 親戚
get along: 相處融洽
解析：題目詢問「李中士是你的親戚嗎？」。relative 表親屬關係，因此答案選A（是的，我們是一家人）。選項B談論相處狀況、選項C稱對方是英雄皆答非所問；選項D表示對方尚未返回，則為無關情境的干擾。

questions.stem: We eat out once in a while.
questions.explain:
eat out: 在外用餐
once in a while: 偶爾、有時候
seldom: 很少、不常
frequently: 經常、頻繁地
解析：題意為「我們偶爾在外用餐」。「once in a while」同義於「sometimes」，故答案選C。干擾選項A的never（從不）、B的seldom（很少）與D的frequently（經常）皆為頻率副詞混淆陷阱，程度與題意不符。

questions.stem: Major Stone is still single.
questions.explain:
single: 單身的、未婚的
Major: 少校
not married yet: 尚未結婚
解析：題意為史東少校依然單身。single代表未婚，與B選項意思相同，故答案選B。選項A的singing及選項C的simple是利用與single發音相近的常見聽力干擾陷阱，皆非正確釋義。

questions.stem: I'm really starved.
questions.explain:
starved: 非常飢餓的
be in big trouble: 遇到大麻煩
deep in debt: 負債累累
解析：題意為「我真的餓壞了」。starved 表示極度飢餓，意思等同于 very hungry，故答案選A。選項B表示驚訝，C表示面臨麻煩，D表示欠債，皆與飢餓完全無關，屬於情境與語意不相干的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Our vacation is drawing to an end.

options.B: Our vacation has been called off.
options.C: Our vacation is coming to a close.

questions.explain:
draw to an end: 接近尾聲、即將結束
come to a close: 漸近尾聲、結束
call off: 取消
postpone: 延期
解析：題幹意為「我們的假期即將結束」。片語 draw to an end 與 come to a close 意思相同，故答案選C。干擾選項A為即將到來，選項B為被取消，選項D為被延期，意思皆與題意不符。

questions.stem: I don't want to take a chance.

options.A: I don't want to take a risk.
options.B: I don't want to make a change.
options.C: I don't want to take over.
options.D: I don't want to make trouble.

questions.explain:
take a chance: 冒險
take a risk: 承擔風險
take over: 接管
解析：題意為「我不想冒險」。片語 take a chance 等同於 take a risk，故答案選A。選項B的 change 與 chance 發音相近，是常見的聽力聲音陷阱；C為接管、D為製造麻煩，語意皆與題目不合。

questions.stem: This chapstick was a giveaway from watsons.
questions.explain:
chapstick: 護唇膏
giveaway: 贈品
bargain: 特價品、便宜貨
解析：題意為這支護唇膏是屈臣氏送的贈品。giveaway指免費贈送物，與present（禮物、贈品）意思最相近，故答案選B。選項A的prize指比賽或抽獎獲得的獎品；C的bargain是花錢買到的便宜貨；D的must-have是必備品，皆非免費贈品。

questions.stem: The earthquake claimed thousands of lives.

options.A: Thousands of people died in the earthquake.
options.B: Thousands of people were missing after the earthquake.
options.C: The earthquake left thousands of people homeless.
options.D: The earthquake scared thousands of people.

questions.explain:
claim lives: 奪走性命、致死
earthquake: 地震
解析：題幹 claim lives 為常考片語，意指「奪走性命」，與 A 選項的 died 意思相同，故答案選A。干擾選項 B（失蹤 missing）、C（無家可歸 homeless）及 D（害怕 scared）皆為災難情境常見詞，但並非奪命的原意，屬於語意過度延伸的陷阱。

questions.stem: When it comes to cooking, my wife is all thumbs.

options.A: My wife is a good cook.
options.B: My wife is bad at cooking.
options.C: My wife rarely cooks at home.
options.D: My wife enjoys cooking very much.

questions.explain:
When it comes to: 談到、提及
all thumbs: 笨手笨腳的、不靈巧的
解析：原句意為「談到做菜，我太太笨手笨腳的」。片語 all thumbs 形容雙手不靈活、拙於某事，即不擅長烹飪，故答案選B。干擾選項A是陷阱，容易將 thumbs 誤聯想為「比讚」而以為廚藝好；選項C與D則無中生有提及做菜頻率與喜好，均不符原意。

questions.stem: You eat like a bird.
questions.explain:
eat like a bird: 食量極小
picky: 挑剔的、挑食的
解析：題幹 eat like a bird 為常見慣用語，形容像鳥一樣吃得很少，故答案選A。選項B表示一直吃，意思完全相反；選項C指挑食，非食量問題；選項D為常見諺語「人如其食」，純屬動詞 eat 的字面干擾。

questions.stem: George is crazy about the actress.

options.A: He is very much in love with the actress.
options.B: He thinks highly of the actress.
options.C: He is very angry with the actress.
options.D: He believes the actress is insane.

questions.explain:
be crazy about: 熱愛、著迷於
think highly of: 高度評價、看重
insane: 發瘋的、精神失常的
解析：題意為喬治對該女演員非常著迷，片語 be crazy about 表示極度喜愛或迷戀，故答案選A。干擾項 C 與 D 是字面陷阱，將 crazy 誤解為生氣（angry）或精神失常（insane）；B 表看重，語意均不符。

questions.stem: Mr. Grey is a dog person.

options.C: He has a dog named Peterson.

questions.explain:
dog person: 喜愛狗的人
work like a dog: 拚命工作
sleep like a log: 睡得很沉
解析：題意指格雷先生是個愛狗人士，故答案選D。選項A「拚命工作」與B「睡得很熟」是利用含dog或押韻片語干擾；選項C則是把person與人名Peterson混淆的發音陷阱。

questions.stem: Tom is a good-for-nothing.
questions.explain:
good-for-nothing: 一無是處的人、沒用的人
useless: 無用的、沒用的
diligent: 勤奮的
解析：題意為「湯姆是個一無是處的人」。good-for-nothing 指毫無用處，與 useless 同義，故答案選C。選項A負責的、B勤奮的與D細心的皆為正面形容詞，考生容易因看到單字 good 而落入字面陷阱誤選。

questions.stem: You are burying your head in the sand.

options.C: You are focusing on your attention.

questions.explain:
bury one's head in the sand: 逃避現實、鴕鳥心態
ignore: 忽視、不理會
解析：片語 bury your head in the sand 源自鴕鳥把頭埋在沙裡的說法，比喻逃避現實、拒絕面對問題，因此答案選D。選項 A 努力工作與選項 C 集中注意力，皆是針對「把頭埋著」所產生的字面引申陷阱，並非該片語的原意。

questions.stem: A female shoplifter was caught on the spot.

options.A: She was caught in another place.
options.C: She was caught in the act.

questions.explain:
shoplifter: 商店竊賊
on the spot: 當場
in the act: 當場、正在犯案時
at large: 逍遙法外
解析：題意為一名女竊賊被當場抓獲。片語 on the spot 表示當場，與 in the act（人贓俱獲、當場犯案）意思相符，故答案選C。干擾項 A 說在其他地點抓到、B 說逍遙法外在逃、D 說躲在某處，皆與「現場當場落網」的文意相反。

questions.stem: Alice is checking the price of the designer bag.

options.A: She is determined to buy the designer bag.
options.B: She is looking at the price tag.
options.C: She is satisfied with the tag price.
options.D: She is haggling over the price.

questions.explain:
check the price: 查看價格
price tag: 標價籤
haggle over: 討價還價
解析：題意為 Alice 正在查看名牌包的價格。looking at the price tag（看標價籤）與查看價格意思相符，故答案選B。選項 A（決心要買）、C（對價格滿意）以及 D（討價還價）皆屬於過度延伸題意的情境陷阱。

questions.stem: Using cellphones while driving is no less dangerous than drunk driving.

options.A: Using cellphone while driving is not so dangerous as drunk driving.
options.B: Drunk driving is less dangerous than using cellphone while driving.
options.C: Using cellphone while driving is as dangerous as drunk driving.
options.D: d. Neither drunk driving nor using cellphones while driving is dangerous.

questions.explain:
no less ... than: 和……一樣；不亞於
drunk driving: 酒後駕車
解析：題幹「no less dangerous than」表示不亞於、和……一樣危險，同義於「as dangerous as」，故答案選C。干擾選項A誤指用手機較不危險；B反指酒駕較不危險，皆分出高下而與題意相反；D落入否定字眼陷阱，誤指兩者都不危險。

questions.stem: The movie was a box office hit.

options.A: The movie brought in a lot of money.
options.B: The movie was a complete failure.
options.D: The movie was less popular than expected.

questions.explain:
box office: 票房、售票處
hit: 非常成功的人事物、暢銷
bring in: 賺進、帶來收入
解析：題意為這部電影非常賣座。box office hit 指票房大賣、非常成功的作品，代表帶來龐大收益，故答案選A。選項B的徹底失敗與D的不如預期受歡迎皆與題意完全相反；選項C的獲獎無數則屬於字面推論陷阱，票房賣座不等於贏得許多獎項。

questions.stem: Fred was absent from the staff meeting.

options.A: He did not attend the staff meeting.
options.B: He was busy arranging another meeting.
options.C: he presided over the staff meeting.
options.D: He was meeting with an important client.

questions.explain:
be absent from: 缺席
staff meeting: 員工會議
attend: 出席，參加
preside over: 主持
解析：題意為 Fred 缺席員工會議。片語 be absent from 等同於 did not attend，故答案選A。選項C的 preside over 為主持會議，意思相反；選項B與D提及安排會議或見客戶，題目並未說明缺席原因，為過度推論的干擾項。

questions.stem: Capital punishment has been abolished in many countries.

options.A: Corporal punishment has been abolished in many countries.
options.B: The death penalty has been abolished in many countries.
options.C: Life imprisonment has been abolished in many countries.
options.D: Crime and Punishment has been published in many countries.

questions.explain:
capital punishment: 死刑
abolish: 廢除
corporal punishment: 體罰
解析：題幹指許多國家已廢除死刑。capital punishment 等同 the death penalty，故答案選B。選項A的 corporal punishment 是體罰，為形近字陷阱；C為終身監禁；D利用 Crime and Punishment 與音近字混淆。

questions.stem: The book deals with domestic violence.

options.B: It is about global warming and climate change.
options.D: It is about child abuse or spouse beating.

questions.explain:
deal with: 處理、探討
domestic violence: 家庭暴力
spouse: 配偶
解析：題幹意為「這本書在探討家庭暴力」。家暴涵蓋虐待兒童或毆打配偶等行為，故答案選D。選項A的家務及選項C的家畜，皆是重複使用 domestic 的字面干擾陷阱，B選項則與主題完全無關。

questions.stem: Mr. Taylor is biding his time.

options.D: He is waiting for his chance.

questions.explain:
bide one's time: 靜候時機、等待良機
wait for: 等待
解析：題意為泰勒先生正在等待時機。片語 bide one's time 意指耐心等待合適的機會再行動，與 waiting for his chance 同義，故答案選D。選項C是利用發音相近的 biting 設下聽力陷阱；A和B則是針對 time 做字面聯想的干擾選項，皆非片語原意。

questions.stem: The result is anything but satisfactory.

options.A: The result is he most satisfactory of all.
options.B: The result is more or less satisfactory.
options.C: The result is less satisfactory than anticipated.
options.D: The result is not satisfactory at all.

questions.explain:
anything but: 絕不、一點也不
satisfactory: 令人滿意的
解析：題幹意為「結果根本不令人滿意」。片語 anything but 表示強烈否定，等同 not at all，故答案選D。干擾選項 A（最滿意）與 B（大致滿意）皆忽略了 but 在此的否定涵義，誤將其解讀為正面肯定，屬於字面相反的陷阱。

questions.stem: I'm in no mood to make jokes.

options.A: I don't want to be joked about.
options.B: I don't feel like making jokes.

questions.explain:
in no mood to: 沒有心情做某事
feel like: 想要做某事
make jokes: 開玩笑
解析：題意為「我現在沒心情開玩笑」。片語 be in no mood to 等同於 not feel like，表示不想做某事，因此答案選B。干擾選項A為「不想被開玩笑」，主被動關係錯誤；選項C與D皆表示「熱衷、很想開玩笑」，與原句意思完全相反。

questions.stem: The news came like a bolt out of the blue.

options.A: The news turned out to be false.
options.B: The news came as a shock.
options.C: The news was believed to be true.
options.D: The news was spreading across the globe.

questions.explain:
a bolt out of the blue: 晴天霹靂、出乎意料
come as a shock: 令人震驚
解析：題幹片語 a bolt out of the blue 比喻「晴天霹靂」，形容事情突如其來且令人震驚，與選項 B 意思相符，故答案選B。選項 A（證實為假）與 D（傳遍全球）皆屬無關的語意干擾。

questions.stem: The new plan is a far cry from our original one.

options.A: The new plan is far better than our original one.
options.B: The new plan is inferior to our original one.
options.C: The new plan is the same as our original one.
options.D: The new plan is very different from our original one.

questions.explain:
a far cry from: 相去甚遠、截然不同
original: 原本的、最初的
inferior to: 比...差的、次於
解析：題意指新計畫與原本的大不相同。片語 a far cry from 表「大相逕庭」，故答案選D。選項A利用 far 設字面陷阱誤導為遠遠更好；選項B表較差，選項C表完全相同，皆非片語本意。

questions.stem: M: Wow! It's a high fly to the outfield! W: Too bad the center fielder has caught it. Q: What are they watching?

turns.t: Wow! It's a high fly to the outfield!
Too bad the center fielder has caught it.
What are they watching?

questions.explain:
high fly: 高飛球
outfield: 外野
center fielder: 中外野手
解析：男士驚呼球被打成外野高飛球，女士惋惜中外野手將球接殺。對話中的高飛球、外野及中外野手均為棒球專用術語，因此答案選D。選項A美式足球、B排球與C籃球雖同為球類運動，但比賽規則與場地均無外野接殺機制，純粹是球類名稱的干擾選項。

questions.stem: M: Mrs. Young, I'm happy to tell you that you are going to have a baby! W: Oh, doctor! That's wonderful! I can't wait to tell my husband. Q: How does the woman feel?

turns.t: Mrs. Young, I'm happy to tell you that you are going to have a baby!
Oh, doctor! That's wonderful! I can't wait to tell my husband.
How does the woman feel?

questions.explain:
wonderful: 太棒了、極好的
can't wait to: 迫不及待
disappointed: 感到失望的
解析：醫生告知楊太太懷孕，女士回答太棒了且迫不及待想告訴先生，顯示出她心情非常興奮，故答案選B。選項A困惑、C失望與D恐懼皆與對話中正面喜悅的情緒相反，為情緒形容詞的干擾項。

questions.stem: W: Please give me your passport and ticket. M: Here you are. W: Could you please put your baggage on the scale? Q: What is the man doing?

options.B: He is giving the woman instructions.
options.D: He is checking out of the hotel.

turns.t: Please give me your passport and ticket.
Here you are.
Could you please put your baggage on the scale?
What is the man doing?

questions.explain:
baggage: 行李
scale: 磅秤
check in: 辦理報到手續
解析：女士要求男子出示護照、機票並將行李放上磅秤，符合機場櫃檯辦理登機的流程，故答案選C。干擾項A過海關通常不在此程序秤行李；B主客顛倒，男子是聽從指示而非給指示；D為飯店退房，與機票及行李過磅情境不符。

questions.stem: W: Look what you've done! My dress is ruined. M: I'm terribly sorry! What can I do to help? Here's some water to wash it off. Q: What happened?

options.A: The man spilled something on the woman's clothes.
options.B: The man said something rude to the woman.
options.C: The man ordered too much food.
options.D: The man refused to pay the bill.

turns.t: Look what you've done! My dress is ruined.
I'm terribly sorry! What can I do to help? Here's some water to wash it off.
What happened?

questions.explain:
ruin: 毀壞、弄糟
wash off: 洗掉、沖掉
spill: 潑灑、灑出
解析：女子抱怨洋裝被毀了，男子道歉並拿水要幫忙清洗，可知是男子不小心把東西灑在對方衣服上，故答案選A。選項B說男子言語無禮、C說點太多食物、D說拒絕買單，皆與「用水沖洗」的情境無關，為無中生有的干擾選項。

questions.stem: M: So, how's your father after the heart surgery? W: He's getting better day by day. Q: what does the woman mean?

options.A: Her father may need the man's help again.
options.C: Her father may need another operation.
options.D: Her father has already left the hospital.

turns.t: So, how's your father after the heart surgery?
He's getting better day by day.
what does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
surgery: 手術
day by day: 一天天地、逐漸
recover: 康復、復原
解析：女士表示父親手術後「一天比一天好」，意同穩定康復，故答案選B。選項A需要協助、C再次手術及D已經出院，對話中均未提及，皆屬於過度推論的干擾選項。

questions.stem: M: You're not going to believe it, but my boss has finally given me a raise! W: You deserve it, John. Q: According to the woman, what does John deserve?

turns.t: You're not going to believe it, but my boss has finally given me a raise!
You deserve it, John.
According to the woman, what does John deserve?

questions.explain:
give someone a raise: 給某人加薪
deserve: 應得、值得
promotion: 升遷、晉升
解析：男士說老闆終於幫他加薪（raise），女士認為是他應得的。raise 即為 more pay（更多薪資），故答案選D。選項 B 的 promotion（升遷）是職場常見的干擾概念，但對話並未提及職務調整；A 與 C 則完全未提及。

questions.stem: W: We're running late. Let's hurry. M: It's no big deal if we are a few minutes late. Q: What does the man mean?

options.B: Being a few minutes late is nothing serious.

turns.t: We're running late. Let's hurry.
It's no big deal if we are a few minutes late.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
run late: 快要遲到
no big deal: 沒什麼大不了
punctual: 準時的
解析：男士表示遲到幾分鐘「no big deal（沒什麼大不了）」，與B選項「nothing serious（不嚴重）」意思相同，故答案選B。選項C是女士的催促而非男士看法；D與男士不在乎稍微遲到的態度相反；A提及總是遲到則屬於過度推論，皆為干擾項。

questions.stem: M: Did you speak out the doctor's name? W: Well, it was on the tip of my tongue, but it escaped me. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.A: She couldn't remember the doctor's name.
options.B: She has already talked too much.
options.C: She managed to escape from the hospital.
options.D: She has decided to keep silent.

turns.t: Did you speak out the doctor's name?
Well, it was on the tip of my tongue, but it escaped me.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
on the tip of one's tongue: 話就在嘴邊、差點想起來
escape someone: 被某人遺忘、想不起來
解析：女士說醫生的名字就在嘴邊但一時忘了，意思是想不起來，故答案選A。C選項是利用 escape 的字面意思「逃跑」設計的字面陷阱；B與D則完全偏離對話原意。

questions.stem: W: We have a great package deal that I'd like to recommend to you. M: But my wife and I want to fly business class. Q: Who is the woman?

turns.t: We have a great package deal that I'd like to recommend to you.
But my wife and I want to fly business class.
Who is the woman?

questions.explain:
package deal: 套裝行程
business class: 商務艙
travel agent: 旅行社代辦人員
解析：女士向男士推薦套裝行程，男士則提出想搭乘商務艙，可知女士是旅行社業務，答案選A。選項B空服員是字面陷阱，容易因聽到搭乘商務艙而誤選，但空服員不會負責推銷旅遊套案；C飯店經理與D餐廳老闆則與對話內容無關。

questions.stem: W: Hi, Andy. How is it going? M: Not bad. What about you, Mandy? Q: What are they doing?

options.B: Getting to know each other better.

turns.t: Hi, Andy. How is it going?
Not bad. What about you, Mandy?
What are they doing?

questions.explain:
How is it going?: 近況如何
exchange greetings: 互相問候
gossip: 說閒話
解析：對話中兩人互稱名字並詢問近況，屬於典型的日常寒暄，故答案選C。干擾選項A自我介紹不正確，因為雙方早已認識；B加深了解與D聊他人八卦皆未在簡短問候中發生，純屬過度推論。

questions.stem: Most kids _______ rather play than study. Your son is no exception.
questions.explain: rather前用would表會比較喜歡

questions.stem: I have no _____ at all. I don't feel like eating anything.
questions.explain: appetite為“食慾”, “胃口”不想吃東⻄為沒有胃口

questions.stem: I stayed in Paris for 6 years, during _____ time I studied art and design.
questions.explain: which time為關係代名詞意旨在前述那段時間

questions.stem: There will ______ no additional charges for our after-sales service.
questions.explain: There will be為無人稱的“有＂,沒有售後服務追加的費用

questions.stem: Jenny has caught her younger brother ______ money from her purse several times.
questions.explain: 當場抓到人偷竊steal動詞後要加ing

questions.stem: On the way home, we were ______ in a traffic jam for two hours.
questions.explain: 被塞在車陣中用被動式表達

questions.stem: Who he is or where he is from _____ no business of mine.
questions.explain: is (are) no business of mine為“沒有我的事”或“跟我無關”

questions.stem: ________ as I sympathize with those victims, I'm not able to offer any help.
questions.explain:
Much as: = although
雖然我同情那些受害者，但我無法提供任何協助。

questions.stem: Nick's _____ against women has come from his many failed relationships.
questions.explain: prejudice against + 人為“對某人有偏見”

questions.stem: Bill Gates is as rich a man as ever ____________.
questions.explain: ever lived表前無古人,意即以前活過的人,故用過去式

questions.stem: My dad used to say, "There is _____ like smoking after a meal."
questions.explain: There is nothing沒有甚麼比飯後一根菸更爽的了

questions.stem: Finally the police ______ called in to disperse the crowd.
questions.explain: the police為“警方”,為集合名詞,當複數用

questions.stem: I prefer watching DVDs at home _____ going to the movies.
questions.explain: prefer + Ving….to + Ving為比較前者甚於後者

questions.stem: My older brother ______ career solider since 1995.
questions.explain: since + 年代之句型,主要句子內之動詞使用現在完成式

questions.stem: George refrained from drinking too much alcohol ____ he should forget himself.
questions.explain: lest為“以免”, George不敢喝醉酒,免得不省人事

questions.stem: A school of fish swam next to me when I went ______ diving in the ocean.
questions.explain: go scuba diving為“潛水”; go snorkeling為“浮潛”

questions.stem: A lot of black Americans are going to Africa to search for their _____.
questions.explain: roots為“根”,到非洲尋根
mean為"平均值"

questions.stem: For your safety, please hold on to the rail and don't _______
questions.explain: let go為“放手”

questions.stem: The time will come _______ you'll regret everything you've just said.
questions.explain: 用when表到時候你會後悔你剛說過的話

questions.stem: If anyone asks you where I am, ______ them I'll be in the library all afternoon.
questions.explain: tell + 人稱受格是祈使句或命令句, “跟他說”使用原形

questions.stem: This material can ______ heat of up to 800 degrees Celsius.
questions.explain: withstand為“承受”, “禁得起”

questions.stem: Most of the village people are concerned about _______ another tsunami will strike again.
questions.explain: whether “是否”海嘯(tsunami)會再重創

questions.stem: The summit of world leaders ____ global warming and food security.
questions.explain: center on為“以….為主”, “聚焦”

questions.stem: Though my parents disapprove _____ my boyfriend, I'm still going to marry him.
questions.explain: (dis)approve + of表“(不)贊成”

questions.stem: Make sure you give us a call _____ you get out of the plane.
questions.explain: as soon as為“一……..就…….”

questions.stem: One-third of the crew on the ship _____ said to be under the weather.
questions.explain: one third為“1/3”,crew為“組員”當複數名詞用

questions.stem: Let's go grab a bite before the movie, ___________?
questions.explain: Let’s後的反問句使用shall we “好嗎?”

questions.stem: A cup of coffee in the morning will definitely _____ your spirits.
questions.explain: lift 某人的spirits為“提升精神或士氣”

questions.stem: It was _______ the 1870s that the modern American football game came into being.
questions.explain: not until用否定表“直到”

questions.stem: Jack is 45 years now, but by 35 he _____ a lot of money in the stock market.
questions.explain: 現在為45歲,在35歲前就完成的事使用過去完成式,強調就已在股市大賺了

questions.stem: _______ poor is nothing be shamed of.
questions.explain: 句首的動詞當主詞需+ ing

questions.stem: Bethlehem is ______ only two kilometers south of Jerusalem near the Dead Sea.
questions.explain: be located為"位於"

questions.stem: Have you got a pen? I need one __________.
questions.explain: 需要一支筆用來寫字,介系詞用with

questions.stem: Nana ________ my invitation to dinner because she said she was otherwise engaged.
questions.explain: decline為“回絕”

questions.stem: Scientists are reporting a new way to identify when a heart transplant recipient is starting to reject the new organ. The human immune system is programmed to reject foreign bodies. It's how we fight off infections. That's one of the biggest obstacles in an organ transplant: the body sees the new organ as foreign. The "foreign bodies" may refer to _________.
questions.explain:
immune system: 免疫系統
foreign body: 外來異物
reject: 排斥
解析：文中提到免疫系統排斥異物是為了抵抗感染，醫學上 foreign bodies 指侵入體內的細菌與病毒，故答案選D。選項A將 foreign 字面誤解為外太空的外星生物，屬於字面陷阱；B與C是人體生存必需物質，並非免疫系統排斥的有害病原。

questions.stem: In late February, inspired by uprisings by Arabs elsewhere, Iraqis held their own protests in Baghdad's Tahrir Square. They were attacked by security forces, and the protests did not blossom at national level. According to the passage, which of the following statements is true?

options.A: The protests were inspired by the Western countries.
options.C: The protests happened only at local level.

questions.explain:
uprising: 起義、暴動
blossom: 蓬勃發展、開展
security forces: 安全部隊
解析：題意問何者敘述正確。文中提到抗議「未在全國層面開展」，且僅在巴格達舉行，顯示僅停留在地方層級，故答案選C。干擾項A受其他阿拉伯人啟發而非西方；B顛倒事實，是抗議者遭安全部隊攻擊；D提及入獄則是文章完全未提及的陷阱。

questions.stem: Cambodia, a beautiful country in Southeast Asia, is most famous for Angkor Wat. But this country is not completely free from danger because there are still up to 6,000,000 live landmines buried around the countryside. Therefore, travelers must stick to the main roads for safety. Why is Cambodia not completely safe?

options.B: The live landmines everywhere can kill people.
options.C: There is war still going on.
options.D: There are no traffic lights on the road.

questions.explain:
live landmine: 未爆地雷
stick to: 遵循、不偏離
解析：題目詢問柬埔寨為何不安全。文中明確指出鄉間埋有數百萬顆未爆地雷，因此答案選B。選項A衛生不良、C仍有戰爭及D缺乏紅綠燈，均為短文中完全未提及的無中生有干擾選項。

questions.stem: Alabama Governor Robert Bentley said Tuesday that the violent tornadoes have killed 131 people in his state, and that he expected the death toll to rise. He added that several counties have experienced massive property destruction, and that up to one million people may be without power. According to the passage, the 131 deaths were caused by ____________.
questions.explain:
violent: 猛烈的
tornado: 龍捲風
death toll: 死亡人數
解析：題意詢問造成131人死亡的原因。文中明確指出是 violent tornadoes（猛烈龍捲風）造成，龍捲風屬於暴風雨的一種，故答案選C。選項A地震、B海嘯與D乾旱均為其他自然災害的字面陷阱，文中完全未提及。

questions.stem: Many parts of the world have been using too much nitrogen fertilizer, and that harms the environment. It contributes to smog, acid rain, loss of biodiversity, global warning, and ozone layer depletion. The list is quite long. What does "loss of biodiversity" mean?

options.A: More and more species are being extinct.
options.B: More and more people are dying from hunger.
options.C: Less and less water is available.
options.D: Less and less food is available.

questions.explain:
biodiversity: 生物多樣性
extinct: 絕種的
解析：題幹問 loss of biodiversity（生物多樣性喪失）的意思。biodiversity 指生物物種多樣化，喪失即代表物種滅絕，故答案選A。選項 B、C、D 提到的飢餓、缺水與糧食短缺為環境惡化後的衍生問題，非該專有名詞的定義，屬於過度延伸推論的干擾項。
